brief: Small English stationery, correspondence, ticket and publishing UI details. No large pictures, illustrations or engravings.

concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a refined NEW design concept for the existing Albion Android English-learning app. The user specifically REJECTED large pictures, illustrations, botanical drawings, buildings and engravings. They LIKE the small envelope-flap treatment of the burgundy learning card and the small circular LONDON postal cancellation in the supplied crops. Extend that preference into an elegant contemporary UI full of small meaningful British stationery details. This is NOT an illustrated vintage theme.

Input roles: image 1 is the admired burgundy envelope card detail; image 2 is the admired small ink postmark; image 3 is the app's current home screen and structure reference.

Deliver one landscape design board titled in small understated type "01 / PRIVATE CORRESPONDENCE". Composition: two large fully visible straight-on flat Android screen designs (HOME and VOCABULARY), plus a narrow right-hand column of six enlarged UI DETAIL swatches. Keep everything flat, no devices, no real-life props. Most of the board must be useful actual app UI. The right column shows isolated reusable UI components, not illustrations.

Design direction: private English correspondence, crisp letterhead, modern luxury stationery. On HOME retain Albion masthead and its narrow square Caslon A monogram, "Good evening.", session selection "5 10 20", and "Начать · 10 ответов". Make the crimson daily session card subtly resemble an envelope: shallow V-shaped flap at the bottom using two slightly darker crimson geometric folds, tiny flat antique-gold circular A seal centred at the V, no bulky wax blob or 3D metallic rendering. Add one small incomplete circular "LONDON / ALBION / 27 OCT" ink cancellation with four delicate wavy rules near the upper right margin, much smaller than the heading and clear of all text. Use a slim perforated edge around a small word-of-the-day panel, a folded-corner bookmark on a section card, a short dotted address-style divider, modest blind-embossed "A" in an otherwise empty card corner, and a tiny gold lozenge progress marker. Every decorative detail should double as a boundary, index, progress indicator, label or heading accent.

VOCABULARY: clean cream front card with "journey", "/ˈdʒɜːni/", a small B1 label shaped like a postage stamp, a slim envelope pocket line at its bottom, and "Показать ответ". Do not reveal the Russian translation before the answer. The actual exercise must be generous and clean; no central decorative image.
Right-hand detail column: miniature envelope flap, circular cancellation plus wave rules, perforated B1 tag, folded corner, small A seal, dotted rule. Label with tiny clean words "Flap", "Postmark", "Level", "Bookmark", "Seal", "Divider".

Palette only Ivory #F6F1E7, Crimson #861F39, Antique Gold #C6A66D, Charcoal #24272B and subtle tints. Barely visible paper grain. Primary display typography Adobe Caslon Pro appearance, Russian headings Cormorant Garamond, all UI controls, numbers, exercise words and IPA clean modern Inter sans serif. The "Albion" brand must be serif. Book prose if any Literata. Small radii, hairline rules, restrained high quality.
Bottom nav on screens: "Карточки", "Учебник", "Чтение", "Практика", "Прогресс".
ABSOLUTE EXCLUSIONS: no illustrations, no engravings, no landscapes, no buildings, no flowers, no quills, no open-book drawings, no animals, no portraits, no large heraldic crests, no ornate decorative borders. Only small geometric stationery and typographic UI motifs. Keep ornaments quiet and contemporary; no excessive distressing.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a NEW alternative concept for Albion, the elegant Android English learning app shown in reference image 3. Reference image 1 shows the SMALL envelope-flap detail the user likes, and image 2 the SMALL London postal cancellation they like. The user wants more modest British-signifying UI elements and explicitly DOES NOT WANT drawings, illustrations, engravings or pictorial scenes. Respect this absolutely.

Concept title: "02 / THE ENGLISH TICKET". One landscape design board: two large, fully visible straight-on flat Android app screens side by side (HOME and PRACTICE SETUP), followed by a slim right column of SIX reusable component close-ups. No physical phones, no outside props. Show functioning modern app interfaces whose small shape and typographic details recall English railway tickets and luggage tags. This is an English-learning app, not a travel booking app: all main actions must stay about learning.

Visual grammar: very fine twin-line keylines, discreet semicircular ticket notches in card edges, a narrow detachable stub holding the session count, small punched progress holes that fill with gold, vertically set tiny "ALBION / LONDON" indexing on a card's stub, typographic "FIRST CLASS" as a tiny decorative eyebrow, a compact rectangular ink stamp "COMPLETED" for a finished lesson, an elongated luggage-label-shaped B1 level tag with a tiny hole represented as a simple ring. Restrained small serif station-sign-style section plaque, narrow crimson bookmark tab. Use different elements selectively, not every surface decorated. These must be plain geometric UI primitives, NOT drawings of real tickets or vintage ephemera. Slight tactile paper edges, almost no shadow. Primary daily-session panel is still crimson, with two tiny side notches and a restrained ivory detachable answer count strip. No enormous timeline, no map or rails.

HOME text: "Albion", "Good evening.", "Время для английского", "5", "10", "20", "Начать · 10 ответов", "Цель дня", "23 / 30", "Ваш маршрут".
PRACTICE screen: "Практика", "Ввод ответа", "Выберите колоду", "Слова", "Уровень", "B1", "Длина занятия", "10 заданий", "Начать". Clean readable control labels and exercise text.
Both bottom navs: "Карточки", "Учебник", "Чтение", "Практика", "Прогресс".
Right column detail labels and components: "Ticket notch" with a small blank bordered notched rectangle; "Session stub" with "10"; "Level tag" with "B1"; "Progress punches" showing 7 tiny circles, 4 filled; "Completion stamp" showing "COMPLETED / ALBION"; "Section plaque" showing "PRACTICE". All details are crisp thin geometry and typography.

Palette strictly Ivory #F6F1E7, Crimson #861F39, Antique Gold #C6A66D, Charcoal #24272B. Barely perceptible paper texture. Preserve lots of ivory negative space. Adobe Caslon Pro appearance for Albion and English display headings, Cormorant Garamond for Russian headings, clean modern Inter for all UI labels, numerals and exercise content. Small outlined interface icons, precise contemporary spacing, no retro illegibility.
STRICTLY NO illustrations, no trains, no landscapes, no maps, no building outlines, no plants, no quills, no open-book drawings, no animals, no royal coat of arms, no flags, no large emblems. No ornate curls or image-filled panels. The Englishness comes entirely from original small stationery-inspired geometry, lettering, stamps and formatting.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create another concept for Albion, an aristocratic but contemporary Android app for learning English. Concept "03 / PRIVATE MEMBERS' EDITION". Use the attached crops as style cues for SMALL UI details: envelope folds, modest seals and ink postmarks; image 3 is the actual existing app structure. The user rejected all large decorative pictures and engravings. This concept must contain ABSOLUTELY ZERO illustrative artwork.

Composition: one landscape presentation board, two large straight-on flat app screen designs side by side (HOME and LEARNING PROGRESS), plus a narrow column on the right showing six small component close-ups. All screens fully visible with no physical device shell, no perspective, no real-world scene. Dark theme that is crisp, not fantasy or excessive luxury.

Design language: quiet London private club stationery, English membership cards and correspondence. Charcoal #24272B background, Ivory #F6F1E7 text, Crimson #861F39 reserved for the daily ritual card and a few active states, Antique Gold #C6A66D hairlines. Barely perceptible dark bookcloth texture. No wood, no metal slabs, no shiny 3D gold, no pictures of a room.

Create many DISTINCT restrained details that are shapes and typesetting only: a tiny square corner bracket monogram cartouche with "A"; a double-rule member-card frame with its lower line broken by a very small serif folio number; a slim crimson bookmark tab dropping 16 logical pixels from the top of one panel; a small round gold-outline seal containing only A; a tiny thin circular ink-style stamp reading "LONDON / SW1 / ALBION", with two wave cancellation lines on an unused edge; an oblique small "COMPLETED" stamp for finished grammar lessons; a fine vertical pinstripe ONLY on a short narrow card stub; a tiny round pin at a progress line's current position. Leave broad negative space. Include an elegant envelope crease along the bottom 8% of the crimson daily study block, with one very small matte gold A seal, taking inspiration from the user's crop. No geometric ornament needs to repeat over an entire screen. Every detail should have a UI role (level, bookmark, completed state, section number, progress).

HOME copy: "Albion", "Good evening.", "Время для английского", "5", "10", "20", "Начать · 10 ответов", "Цель дня", "23 / 30", "Ваш маршрут".
PROGRESS copy: "Ваш прогресс", "12" "дней подряд", "86%" "точность", a clean and understated 30-day calendar heatmap in gold/ivory tints, "Завершённые темы", two compact typographic completed lesson rows, and a small italic footer "A little, every day."
Bottom navigation on both screens: "Карточки", "Учебник", "Чтение", "Практика", "Прогресс".
Right column detail labels: "Monogram", "Member card", "Ribbon tab", "London stamp", "Completed", "Folio rule". Each accompanied by a tiny geometric UI sample, no figurative shapes.
Typography: Adobe Caslon Pro appearance for Albion and English display words, Cormorant Garamond for Russian large headings, modern INTER sans serif for ALL other controls, numbers, metrics, descriptions and navigation. Restrained outlines, small radii, precise spacing, highly legible text.
HARD EXCLUSIONS: no lions, no crowns, no coats of arms, no laurel wreaths, no flowers or plants, no buildings, no shelves, no book drawings, no quills, no illustrations, no engravings, no pictorial watermarks, no large emblems, no ornamental wallpaper. The British character must be encoded entirely in microtypography, membership-card shapes, correspondence details, small stamps, corner rules and disciplined composition.

Use case: ui-mockup. Generate concept "04 / THE LONDON READING ROOM" for the existing Albion Android English learning app. It must satisfy the user's clarified preference: English character from SMALL tactile and typographic UI details such as an envelope fold and postal cancellation, with NO illustrations, NO engravings, NO large decorative images. Reference 1 is the liked envelope detail, reference 2 the liked postmark; reference 3 is the current Albion home layout. This fourth variation should feel like an elegant English publisher's edition and library catalogue, distinct from literal mail and railway tickets.

Create one landscape presentation board with TWO large fully visible flat Android screen designs side by side (HOME and BOOK READER), plus a narrow right column of SIX reusable UI detail close-ups. Straight-on, no phones, no perspective, no real-life props. Light ivory theme, calm contemporary layout, no pictorial content.

Art direction: modern English literary publishing and refined bookbinding translated into UI shapes. Keep Albion's square Caslon A masthead. On HOME, the daily session block is crimson like the plain cloth cover of an English edition, with a narrow slightly darker vertical spine strip at its left, three tiny gold horizontal bands on that strip and very fine double gold tooling around the panel. Use no artwork or ornament inside this frame. At the right edge show just two fine parallel ivory lines as the suggestion of paper fore-edge, not a 3D book. Use a thin crimson ribbon tab on a reading-continuation panel, a small index-card header tab reading "READING", a tiny rectangular library accession stamp "ALBION / LONDON / 027", a miniature serif folio "IV" between short gold rules, a small incomplete circular date stamp near one empty header margin, and a folded ivory paper corner marking a saved lesson. Plenty of uninterrupted whitespace. Decorative details should be small and have a functional meaning: bookmark, saved state, section index, date, level.

HOME exact text: "Albion", "Good afternoon.", "Время для английского", "5", "10", "20", "Начать · 10 ответов", "Цель дня", "23 / 30", "Продолжить чтение", "The Keeper of Gull Island".
BOOK READER: understated small running head "ALBION / THE READING ROOM", chapter numeral "VI", serif title "The Light", beautifully set short prose about a lighthouse in a clean wide column. Small initial drop cap formed purely from typography, no decoration. Narrow clean bookmark ribbon in the upper right margin. One very small catalogue index number at the bottom, and a page counter "19 / 22". A fine typographic section break made from three tiny lozenges. Reading text must be completely unobstructed; all decorative marks stay in margins or running heads. No side illustration or graphic background.
Bottom nav on home only: "Карточки", "Учебник", "Чтение", "Практика", "Прогресс".
Detail column labels and geometric examples: "Spine bands", "Double rule", "Ribbon bookmark", "Catalogue tab", "Accession stamp", "Folio divider". These are purely abstract UI primitives and typography. The small bookbinding spine bands should be THREE short horizontal gold strokes on a crimson strip; no book drawing.

Palette limited to Ivory #F6F1E7, Crimson #861F39, Antique Gold #C6A66D, Charcoal #24272B with subtle tints. A very fine paper grain, no strong yellow sepia. Adobe Caslon Pro appearance for Albion and English chapter title, Cormorant Garamond for Russian display headings, Inter sans serif for ALL controls, exercise words, numerals, labels and navigation, Literata for book prose. Slim line icons, modern generous spacing, very restrained shadows and small corners. Make it sophisticated and implementable, not a scrapbook.
ABSOLUTELY NO illustrations, engravings, pictorial scenes, flowers, trees, architecture, quills, book illustrations, large shields, animals, crowns, ornamental curls, flag wallpaper or big logos. Do not turn the panels into realistic physical books. Englishness comes entirely from small bookbinding geometries, publisher typography, library stamps, catalogue tabs and fine rules.
